rationale: A single-operator denominator swap on the archive champion, but a defensible one — dp/sale is mechanically dp/at divided by asset turnover, so the test cleanly decomposes whether the champion's moderator works through capital consumption or through the asset-base denominator, though the incremental information over the champion is likely modest and the result will be highly correlated with it.

Asset turnover is a well-known DuPont-component predictor (Soliman 2008) so the leg itself is not novel, but its interaction with a mid-cycle-normalized yield is untested in this archive and economically distinct from depreciation intensity; note it is close to the reciprocal-complement of Proposal 1, so the two should be interpreted jointly rather than as independent evidence.

MIN(oiadp, MA5) is the one remaining cell of a three-point grid whose other two points (plain average 3.4%, MAX envelope 3.0%) already produced near-identical results, so the expected incremental information is small — but the conservative anchor does correspond to a genuinely different economic screen and the expression matches the hypothesis exactly.

Horizon-matching the accrual conditioner to the five-year valuation numerator is a coherent and non-cosmetic upgrade on the earlier one-year accrual gate, though the leg is a straightforward long-window Sloan accrual measure, the flow-numerator/stock-denominator scaling (5-year sum over current at) is internally inconsistent in units, and the oancf plus five-year window will bite coverage.

This is a pure monotone re-transformation of the champion that simultaneously and silently deletes every firm with non-positive mid-cycle operating profit, so any change in alpha confounds tail compression with a large sample-selection shift — exactly the coverage-driven "apparent improvement" the objective warns against — and the stated distress story concerns the sample screen, not the log itself.

Both legs are already in the archive (IntangibleCapitalIntensity_x_TotalCapitalEbitdaYield and the normalized earnings yield used by six prior signals), making this a mix-and-match grid cell rather than a new mechanism, and the stated attribution logic is weak since a middling result would be equally explicable by the known noisiness of accumulated-xsga proxies.
